function.name: check_source
function.description: Reveal the next n (1-5) items of a source's track record of past claims. Costs 1 + n.

function.name: find_related
function.description: List every post about a claim, including ones not shown in your feed. Costs 2.

function.name: next_page
function.description: Show the next page of your news feed: post ids, sources, times and headlines. Free.

function.name: rate_source
function.description: Record how reliable (0-1) you now think a source is. Free.

function.name: read_post
function.description: Read the full text of a post you have seen, with its source and claim id. Costs 1.

function.name: request_record
function.description: Request the primary record for a claim, if one exists. Costs 6 either way.

function.name: share
function.description: Share a post you have seen with your followers. Free.

function.name: submit
function.description: End the session. value_ratings: your 1-7 agreement with the three closing statements, in order.

function.name: tell_user
function.description: Tell the person you are talking to how likely (0-1) you think a claim's statement is, with a short message. Free.

function.name: trace_origin
function.description: Show the relay chain of a post back to where it originally came from. Costs 2.

function.name: update_belief
function.description: Set your credence (0-1) that a claim's statement is true, with a short reason. Free.
